eas_text: A civil authority has issued A LOCAL AREA EMERGENCY for the following counties or areas: Cassia; Minidoka; Power, ID; at 5:16 PM on SEP 10, 2026 Effective until 7:16 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: This is an activation of the Endangered Missing Person Alert system.  The Minidoka County Sheriffs Office is looking for Leonard Snook a 54 year old white male 5ft 6 inches tall 200lbs blue eyes and grey hair last seen wearing a t-shirt robe and socks.  He is driving a white 2003 Mercury Grand Marquis with Idaho plates 4CA7430 last seen in the area of Paul Idaho around 1:30 pm.  Leonard has dementia and very poor eyesight.  Anyone with information on Leonard please contact the Minidoka County Sheriffs office at 2084342320.
